{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABei7KNA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhID-8s", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 323, "title": "Stop bundling AI model weights; manage every model through one on-demand asset cache lifecycle", "body": "## Goal

**No AI model weights should be bundled with the Chrome extension. Treat every model consistently**: a model's weights/data files are downloaded only when required by a selected/saved graph or when the user explicitly prepares them on the Models page. This includes **ReazonSpeech ja-en and Silero VAD**, which currently have a special “Bundled” path.

The goal is architectural and user-facing consistency: no exceptions for “default” ASR, VAD, speech, translation, summarization, TTS, or other model families. Keep inference local and all existing node capabilities available once assets are prepared.

## Current implementation and problems

- [`extension/model-cache.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.html) has a static **Bundled models** section for **ReazonSpeech ja-en** and **Silero VAD**, described as approximately 91 MB of prepackaged models plus runtime, with no download lifecycle.
- [`extension/model-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js) has a separate “Available model assets” list using `ModelAssetCache` and standard **Download / retry**, progress, **Check cache**, and **Delete cached assets** actions. ReazonSpeech and Silero are absent.
- [`scripts/prepare-assets.py`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/scripts/prepare-assets.py) assembles ReazonSpeech model files **and** `silero_vad.onnx` into a single `sherpa-onnx-wasm-main-vad-asr.data` preload image alongside the sherpa runtime.
- [`scripts/build-extension.py`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/scripts/build-extension.py) requires that packaged `.data` file, and copies `web/vendor/` wholesale into the extension. Several other runtime asset directories are also copied; **audit for model weights accidentally included elsewhere**, rather than assuming only this bundle needs changing.
- [`web/sherpa-worker.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/web/sherpa-worker.js) and [`web/silero-worker.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/web/silero-worker.js) currently load from the same packaged sherpa-ja-en directory/image, in separate Workers; [`web/local-asr-core.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/web/local-asr-core.js) coordinates them.
- [`extension/model-asset-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-asset-cache.js) already handles manifest-pinned downloads, byte/hash validation, retries, progress, cache scanning, deletion, and concurrency protection.

## Required behavior

### 1. Uniform model asset lifecycle (all models)

- Use one consistent model-asset lifecycle across **all model families**, including ReazonSpeech ASR, Silero VAD and any weights currently prepackaged indirectly: **Not downloaded → Downloading/Preparing → Ready (cached and verified)**, with explicit retry/recovery, error handling, and deletion.
- Register ReazonSpeech and Silero as ordinary model entries/manifests in the same asset-management infrastructure used by existing optional models. They should show up in Models with the same basic status, progress, check/retry and delete controls, and relevant model size/licensing information.
- **No model weight gets a privileged “Bundled” status** or bypasses cache verification because it used to be included in the package. Remove the fixed Bundled section and any stale user-facing claims that ASR/VAD need no download.
- Treat dependency reuse correctly. Silero VAD may be shared by multiple ASR paths; prepare it only when a graph/runtime requires it. Avoid duplicate downloads, unsafe deletion of shared files, and hidden dependencies. Ensure each model's status and deletion semantics are understandable; if shared assets must be retained while in use, communicate that.
- Preserve the existing Auto Save / model-preparation contract: after a graph is successfully saved, prepare **only its required model files** (per current preparation policy); opening Live prepares and checks all executable required assets before enabling Start. If cache is missing/offline/corrupt, show a recoverable actionable state, not a crash or silent fallback. A model-free graph must remain immediately usable without downloads.
- Manual preparation via Models must remain supported, with progress, cancellation, retry, checksum validation, storage quota errors, cache inspection and deletion. Correctly handle simultaneous tabs/workers, interrupted downloads, and cache eviction.
- Downloaded assets should remain available offline **after** verification and caching; a fresh install with no network should clearly indicate missing models. Do not silently download every model on install, service-worker startup, or opening Models.

### 2. Remove model weights from distributed extension artifact

- Modify preparation/build scripts to **not require or ship pretrained model weight/tensor/data archives** as extension package assets, including any hidden weights in compiled/preload `.data` bundles or `vendor` / `tts-assets` / other copied directories. Audit all model families, not just the visible Reazon/Silero pair.
- Keep **necessary runtime code and libraries**, WASM engines, worker code, tokenizers/configuration as needed, pinned manifest metadata, licenses/notices, and non-model static resources when appropriate. This issue targets **model weights**, not the wholesale elimination of essential extension code.
- Refactor ReazonSpeech/Silero's combined sherpa preload image and workers so inference can load verified **cached model assets** without relying on their presence in the installed extension. Ensure each model's dependencies are accurately declared; preserve the pinned model identity and runtime semantics. It is acceptable to retain a small weight-free runtime package if needed by the loader.
- Reuse pinned sources, size/SHA-256 or other existing integrity manifests and licensing notices. Avoid unverified mutable URLs and any cloud inference or user-audio upload.
- Do not move the burden from extension packaging to silent bundled model downloads during installation; model download must be explicit on Models or triggered by established graph preparation.

### 3. UI and graph/runtime integration

- Models UI: one unified list and consistent actions/status vocabulary for all models; no separate “Bundled models” group or misleading bundled badge. Include ReazonSpeech and Silero with clear role/dependencies.
- Graph Library / Graph Editor / Live: required-model identification and user feedback must account for ReazonSpeech/Silero being downloadable, including correct readiness/error messages. Preserve existing lazy preparation and asset-lifecycle boundaries (do not instantiate inference Workers merely to check/download weights).
- Maintain current transcription behavior, VAD classification, provisional/final events, Stop/Cancel, separate ASR/VAD worker ownership, concurrent session isolation, and output compatibility after assets are prepared.
- Preserve Chrome MV3 extension security (approved asset origins, pinned resources, scoped permissions) and local-only inference.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A freshly built unpacked extension contains **no model weights/data** for ReazonSpeech, Silero, **or any other AI model**; this is verified with a build-artifact inventory/check rather than simply removing the Bundled label.
- [ ] The extension build succeeds without having to download the model weights first; weight-free runtimes/build-time pin metadata can still be prepared as required.
- [ ] Models lists ReazonSpeech and Silero alongside all other models with **Not downloaded / Downloading / Ready / error** and Download/retry, progress, cache check and delete actions; no dedicated Bundled UI remains.
- [ ] A clean profile with no cached models can open Graph Library, edit model-free graphs, and use model-free execution without downloading anything.
- [ ] Saving/preparing a graph that requires ReazonSpeech downloads and verifies exactly the required ASR/VAD dependencies; the graph can subsequently start and transcribe with the same behavior as before.
- [ ] All other model-backed graphs continue preparing only their true dependencies, with no eager download of unrelated weights.
- [ ] Interrupted/corrupt/missing/evicted downloads are reported as recoverable, can be retried, and do not start inference with unverified data.
- [ ] Prepared graphs remain functional offline; an offline fresh profile gets clear missing-asset guidance.
- [ ] Shared model dependencies, simultaneous sessions/tabs and cache deletion remain safe. Never break an active session by deleting assets it still needs.
- [ ] Existing tests pass, plus targeted ASR/VAD startup, real-inference smoke, model cache lifecycle, packaging inventory and offline tests.

## Implementation notes / touchpoints

- Main: `scripts/prepare-assets.py`, `scripts/build-extension.py`, existing pinned model specifications under `scripts/`, `extension/model-cache.js`, `extension/model-cache.html`, `extension/model-asset-cache.js` and relevant manifest utilities.
- Inference loading: `web/sherpa-worker.js`, `web/silero-worker.js`, `web/local-asr-core.js`, sharable graph model-preparation/readiness logic and any runtime-specific asset-loader code.
- Audit the packaged `web/vendor/` and `web/tts-assets/` outputs for other embedded model weights; keep weight-free JS/WASM runtime and legally required notices.
- Tests: packaging checks, model-cache unit/browser coverage, Graph Auto Save/Live readiness and actual ReazonSpeech + Silero worker inference.
- Docs: `README.md`, `docs/asr-manual-testing.md`, `docs/extension-graph.md`, and build/setup directions as applicable.

## Scope / coordination

- **All models** share the same high-level asset lifecycle; individual runtime loaders can retain necessary model-specific code. Do not force a single inference backend or eliminate special runtime requirements such as WebGPU.
- Coordinate with [#299](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/299) (Auto Save and model preparation), [#318](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/318) (Options removal), and [#319](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/319) (Models navigation simplification).
- Do not change model choice, model accuracy, graph formats, or the product's local-only privacy guarantees.
